sentences.text: Issue notice to the respondents, returnable on 22 July, 2024.
Mr. Patel, learned Add.GP waives for respondent nos.1 and 2.
In addition to the Court notice, learned advocate for the petitioners is permitted to serve respondent nos.3 to 7 by private service and place on record affidavit of service.
Despite service un-served respondents are not represented on the adjourned date of hearing, the Court shall proceed to hear the parties as appearing and pass appropriate orders.
5. Mr. Gorwadkar submits that the case of the petitioners is that they are entitled to compensation in respect of the land, subject matter of acquisition.

It is submitted that the petitioners are the owners,
however, compensation amount is being disbursed to respondent nos.3 to 7 who were erstwhile owners of the subject land.
Accordingly, there is dispute on payment of compensation and/or apportionment of the compensation amount.

It is his submission that in these circumstances, the obligation on the part of respondent nos.1 and 2 was to make a reference of the dispute under the provisions of Section 3H(4) of the National Highways Authority Act, 1956 for a decision of the principal civil Court of original jurisdiction within the limits of whose jurisdiction the land in question is situated.
He submits that in this view of the matter, it would not be appropriate for the competent authority to disburse the compensation to private respondents.

Mr. Gorwadkar has placed reliance on the decision of the Supreme Court in Vinod Kumar vs. District Magistrate Mau1 to submit that it was incumbent on the competent authority to make reference in the circumstances in hand.

entities.text: Vinod Kumar vs. District Magistrate Mau1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: We shall hear the parties on the rival contentions, however, at this stage, as prayer for ad-interim relief is made, we are inclined to grant ad-interim order on this petition by directing respondent nos.1 and 2 not to disburse compensation in favour of respondent nos.3 to 7, if not already paid today by 2.55 p.m.
Ordered accordingly.
7. Reply affidavit, if any, be placed on record on or before the adjourned date of hearing.
(SOMASEKHAR SUNDARESAN, J.) (G. S. KULKARNI , J.) 08 July, 2024 Meena Bhaurao Chaudhari And Ors vs The Competent Authority National ...
